questions.stem: Mike is a little overweight and he needs to go on ________ diet.
questions.expl: 句意：迈克有点超重，他需要节食。 考查冠词。an 一个，表泛指，放在元音音素前；a 一个，表泛指，放在辅音音素前；the 表特指。 go on a diet 是固定搭配，表示“节食”，用a 符合。故选C。

questions.stem: Mike is good at sports and he ________ likes playing basketball. That’s his favourite.
questions.expl: 句意：迈克擅长运动，他尤其喜欢打篮球。那是他的最爱。 考查副词辨析。hardly 几乎不；especially 尤其，特别；freshly 清新地；probably 可能。根据“Mike is good at sports and he...likes playing basketball”和“favourite”可知，此处强调迈克特别喜欢篮球。故选 B。

questions.stem: My mother has a poor ________ of direction (方向), so she is always afraid to go out alone.
questions.expl: 句意：我的妈妈有着较差的方向感，所以她总是害怕一个人出去。 考查名词辨析。sense 感觉；scene 场景；silence 沉默；sound 声音。根据“so she is always afraid to go out alone.”可推测，是指方向感差，a poor sense of direction 表示“方向感差”。故选A。

questions.stem: Repeating information helps move it from ________ to long-term memory.
questions.expl: 句意：重复信息有助于将其从短期记忆转移到长期记忆。 考查形容词辨析。short-term 短期的；good 好的；bad 坏的；long-term 长期的。根据“Repeating information”“to long-term memory”可知，重复信息有助于将其从短期记忆转移到长期记忆。故选A。

questions.stem: Please call me if you ________ next Sunday.
questions.expl: 句意：如果你下周日有空请给我打电话。

questions.stem: If you do one thing at a time and stick to your plan, you ________ some day.
questions.expl: 句意：如果你一次只做一件事，并坚持你的计划，总有一天你会成功。 考查If 引导的条件状语从句的时态。if 引导的条件状语从句结构，从句用一般现在时，主句用一般 将来时，符合“主将从现”原则，故主句需用will succeed。故选A。

questions.stem: If you can _______ the problem, try to find a proper way to solve it.
questions.expl: 句意：如果你能解决这个问题，尽力找一个合适的方法来解决它。look for 寻找；run out of 用完，用尽；figure out 解决；想出；put out 扑灭。根据句意try to find a proper way to solve it 可知， 这里应该是解决问题，故应选C。

questions.stem: You won’t pass the PE exam successfully ________ you exercise every day.
questions.expl: 句意：除非你每天锻炼，否则你不会成功通过体育考试。 考查连词辨析。if 如果；unless 除非；as long as 只要；even if 即使。根据“You won’t pass the PE exam successfully…you exercise every day.”可知，此处说的是除非你每天锻炼。故选B。

questions.stem: We found ________ necessary to take a mobile phone while having a picnic.
questions.expl: 句意：我们发现野餐时有必要带一部手机。 考查代词用法。it’s 它是；it 它；that 那个；what 什么。根据句子结构可知，此处是“find it+形容词 +to do sth.”结构，表示“发现做某事是……的”，其中it 是形式宾语，动词不定式是真正的宾语，所 以此处应该用it。故选B。

questions.stem: —Zhou Shen’s voice is really beautiful and his songs make me ________.—Yeah, listening to his songs is good way to ________.
questions.expl: 句意：——周深的声音真的很美，他的歌让我很放松。——是的，听他的歌是放松的好 方法。 考查形容词和动词。relaxing 令人放松的，通常修饰事物；relaxed 放松的，通常修饰人。根据“make me”可知，修饰人用relaxed。第二个空，不定式作后置定语，to 后跟动词原形relax“放松”。故选B。 二、完形填空(本大题共10 小题，每小题1 分，满分10 分) Hobbies are the things people 11 do for fun in their free time. People may have many different kinds of hobbies, which add colour to their life. 12 do you need hobbies? For a large number of teenagers, doing something they love for an hour or two is a good way to relax. A study has found that people are 13 when they take part in a relaxing activity. Other studies have shown that hobbies can give you a feeling of 14, especially when your hobby helps you get a prize in a competition. Last, developing (发展) hobbies is a good way to meet people who have 15 in common. How do you 16 the right hobby? Start with what you enjoyed in the past. Did you once play football? Take it up again. If you find it isn’t for you, stop and turn to new things. Joining a class or a team will maybe give you a 17 to meet other people, too. Which relaxing activities are the hobbies healthy for you? It’s clear that exercise is going to be good for your body like 18. As a matter of fact, dancing is wonderful exercise. A review of 94 studies has found that dancing three times a week improves people’s balance (平衡能力). Getting out in nature is also helpful whether you are hiking or doing things that aren’t active. Which hobbies keep your 19 active? Music and reading are the best ways. Probably playing the piano or listening to your favorite band can help you make it. Scientists have found reading is also good for your brain (大脑). Hobbies let you forget your worries and 20. What a difference hobbies make! So develop your own great hobbies as soon as you can.

questions.stem: A．hardly
questions.expl: ：兴趣爱好是人们在空闲时间经常做来娱乐的事情。 hardly 几乎不；often 经常；never 从不；usual 通常的。根据“ Hobbies are the things people...do for fun in their free time.”可知，兴趣爱好是人们“经常”在空闲时间做的事情，故选B。

questions.stem: A．Why
questions.expl: ：为什么你需要兴趣爱好？ Why 为什么；How 怎样；What 什么；When 什么时候。根据下文分析兴趣爱好的益处可知，此处 是提出问题“为什么需要兴趣爱好”。故选A。

questions.stem: A．less bored
questions.expl: ：研究发现，当人们参加一种放松的活动时，他们会变得不那么无聊。 less bored 不那么无聊；less interesting 不那么有趣；more boring 更无聊；more difficult 更困难。根 据“when they take part in a relaxing activity”可知参加放松活动会让人不那么无聊。故选A。

questions.stem: A．safety
questions.expl: ：其他研究表明，兴趣爱好可以给你一种成功感。 safety 安全；duty 责任；success 成功；failure 失败。根据“especially when your hobby helps you get a prize in a competition”可知，参加比赛获奖会带来成功感。故选C。

questions.stem: A．anything
questions.expl: ：发展兴趣爱好是结识有共同点的人的好方法。 anything 任何事物；nothing 没有事物；everything 一切；something 某事物。根据“Last, developing (发 展)hobbies is a good way to meet people who have...in common”可知，此处指有“共同点”的人。故选D。

questions.stem: A．share
questions.expl: ：你如何选择合适的兴趣爱好？ share 分享；choose 选择；touch 触摸；make 制造。根据下文“Start with what you enjoyed in the past” 可知，此处是建议如何“选择”合适的兴趣爱好。故选B。

questions.stem: A．change
questions.expl: ：加入一个班级或团队也许会给你一个结识其他人的机会。 change 改变；choice 选择；chance 机会；chick 小鸡。根据“Joining a class or a team will maybe give you a...to meet other people. too.”可知，此处是指结识其他人的“机会”。故选C。

questions.stem: A．eating
questions.expl: ：很明显，锻炼对你的身体有好处，比如散步。 eating 吃；sleeping 睡觉；singing 唱歌；walking 散步。根据“exercise is going to be good for your body” 可知，锻炼对身体有好处，散步是锻炼的一种方式。故选D。

questions.stem: A．health
questions.expl: ：哪些兴趣爱好可以让你的大脑保持活跃？ health 健康；body 身体；mind 大脑；heart 心脏。根据“Music and reading are the best ways”以及 “Scientists have found reading is also good for your brain”可知，音乐和阅读对大脑有益。故选C。

questions.stem: A．make up
questions.expl: ：兴趣爱好让你忘记烦恼并成长。 make up 弥补；grow up 成长；stay up 熬夜；get up 起床。根据下文“What a difference hobbies make! ” 可知，兴趣爱好能让人“成长”。故选B。

questions.stem: Which writing skill is used in paragraph 1?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据“When the famous scientist Albert Einstein was 16 years old, he imagined himself... working out the ‘theory of relativity (相对论)’.”可知，第一段讲述爱因斯坦16 岁时想象自 己和一束光同行，并用这个想象帮助他研究相对论；由此推知第一段运用到的写作技巧是举例。故 选A。 22．词句猜测题。根据“However, try not to let your mind be absent when you need to focus (聚焦) in class or cross the road.”可知，当需要在课堂上集中注意力或过马路时，不要让大脑“走神”，所以 “absent” 在这里的意思是“走神的”。故选B。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word “absent” in Paragraph 4 probably mean in Chinese?
Guo Qiang first suggests ________.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Guo Qiang, an expert in thoughts and feelings, thinks we should all make time to daydream. ”可知，思想和情感专家郭强认为，我们都应该腾出时间做白日梦。故选C。

questions.stem: What is mentioned in paragraph 4?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Guo suggests you can start by focusing on a happy memory or imagining a future success, like scoring a goal in the World Cup.”可知，提到了可以白日做梦的事情。故选B。

questions.stem: Which of the following is TRUE according to the text?
opts: Daydreaming is not helpful in developing creativity.
Disappearing into a daydream helps you deal with worries and fears.
You can’t let your mind be absent when you don’t have to focus on anything.
Daydreaming lets your mind walk slowly around ideas that are happening right now.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Disappearing into a daydream lets your mind escape when things are difficult. It helps you deal with worries and fears.”可知，沉浸在白日梦中有助于处理担忧和恐惧。故选B。

questions.stem: When did the researchers play foreign words for people in Group 1 in the experiment?
opts: Before they went for a walk.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第三段“The researchers played the Dutch words for people in Group 1 while they were asleep”可知，研究人员在第一组人睡着的时候播放荷兰语单词。故选C。

questions.stem: What does the underlined word “them” refer to in Paragraph 3?
What’s the structure of this passage?
questions.expl: 结构题。通读全文可知，第一段主要提出“大脑在睡眠期间是否能学习”的问题；第二至四 段通过实验说明大脑在睡眠期间确实可以学习新事物；第五段说明慢波活动增强有助于提升对新信 息的记忆能力。因此本文的结构为①/②③④/⑤。故选D。

questions.stem: What can we learn from the passage?
opts: Scientists think people can’t learn during sleeping hours.
German speakers enjoy learning Dutch words.
Slow-wave brain activities can help people have a good sleep.
People in Group 3 didn’t remember the words as well as those in Group 1.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据第四段“The third group listened to the words when they walked. The walkers didn’t have the same success in remembering the words as the sleeping group”可知，第三组在走路时听 单词，他们记住单词的效果不如睡眠组。故选D。

questions.stem: Where is the passage most probably from?
questions.expl: 判断题。根据第二段“Scientists aren’t exactly sure how it works, but they have discovered that the brain can learn things during sleeping hours”及全文内容可知，本文主要探讨了睡眠中学习的问题， 属于科学研究范畴，因此最有可能来自科学杂志。故选B。

questions.stem: What are the two main types of memory?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“There are two main types of memory: short-term and long-term.”可知，记忆主 要有两种类型：短期记忆和长期记忆。故选B。

questions.stem: What is short-term memory like?
opts: Can store a lot of information.
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Short-term memory is like a temporary storage.”可知，短期记忆就像一个临时 存储器。故选B。

questions.stem: How can we move information from short-term to long-term memory?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Repeating helps move it from short-term to long-term memory.”可知，重复有 助于将信息从短期记忆转移到长期记忆。故选B。

questions.stem: Why is sleep important for memory?
questions.expl: 理解题。根据“Also, getting enough sleep is crucial because sleep helps strengthen memories.” 可知，睡眠对记忆很重要是因为它有助于增强记忆力。故选A。

questions.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
opts: The types of memory and ways to improve it.B．How to have a good sleep.
questions.expl: 大意题。根据“Memory is a wonderful and complex function of our brain. There are two main types of memory: short-term and long-term.”并结合全文可知，本文主要介绍了记忆的类型和改善记 忆的方法。故选A。
